subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should maintainers adopt this frozen implementation onto current main as the canonical fix, or close it in favor of another candidate?
rationale: The patch has strong proof and maintainer-guided architecture, but the contributor branch is intentionally frozen and conflicting, so only a maintainer can choose and own the current-main landing path.

options.title: Adopt Onto Current Main
options.body: Recreate or rebase the reviewed architecture on current main, resolve conflicts, and require exact merge-result validation before landing it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Choose The Smaller Candidate
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 only if maintainers prefer its narrower contract and first bring its proof and compatibility handling up to the same standard.

options.title: Pause The Recovery Change
options.body: Close the candidate PRs only if maintainers explicitly decide that durable quarantine semantics are not acceptable product behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt Onto Current Main
recommendation.body: Recreate or rebase the reviewed architecture on current main, resolve conflicts, and require exact merge-result validation before landing it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They already supplied the architecture decision, maintained the final implementation, and are best positioned to preserve its invariants during current-main adoption.
